title: Unexclude Vespa on Python 3.14
body:
#74559 marked the provider unavailable on 3.14 because every pyvespa published at the time capped itself at `<3.14`. 1.2.9 lifted that to `<3.16`, so the exclusion has nothing left to stand on.

The floor moves only for 3.14 and up. 1.1.2 still serves 3.11-3.13, and raising it there would force an upgrade on users the cap never affected.

split from: #74696
